profile.headline: Lead Software Developer at BNY Mellon
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Developer with 3+ years of experience designing and building scalable, high-performance applications. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and React, with expertise in developing efficient APIs and intuitive front-end interfaces.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed scalable, high-performance RESTful APIs, using Spring Boot, enabling seamless integration across multiple systems and applications.
• Led migration of multiple legacy systems to cloud-native architecture, streamlining operations and achieving 99.99% uptime across all applications, significantly enhancing system reliability and performance.
• Led a team of interns in developing an automated CI/CD pipeline using GitLab, significantly enhancing code quality and reducing production bugs by 25%.
• Optimized API endpoints by implementing caching strategies, asynchronous processing, and job scheduling, reducing latency by 90%.
• Mentored junior developers on Spring Boot best practices, enhancing team productivity and increasing team satisfaction by 30%.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Designed and developed scalable, high-performance RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, ensuring seamless integration across multiple systems.

•  Led the migration of legacy systems to a cloud-native architecture, enhancing availability and achieving 99.99% uptime.
•  Managed a team of four interns to develop an automated CI/CD pipeline using GitLab, reducing production bugs by 25%.
•  Optimized API performance by implementing caching, asynchronous processing, and job scheduling, cutting latency by 90%.
•  Mentored junior developers on Spring Boot best practices, increasing team productivity and satisfaction by 30%.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built a secure authentication system for HealtheLife using Ruby on Rails and React, enhancing security and user access.
• Developed and deployed a microservice using Ruby on Rails to log and monitor system activity in the HealtheLife application, improving error tracking and performance diagnostics.
• Applied test-driven development (TDD) principles using RSpec and FactoryBot, ensuring high code quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · React.js · Microservices · Agile Methodologies · Test-Driven Development

positions.title: Software Engineering Research Intern
positions.description:
• Researched and developed 3D user interfaces, VR, and AR applications using Unreal Engine 4 and C++.
• Enhanced website UX/UI using HTML, CSS, and React, creating a responsive and dynamic interface.
• Conducted VR usability studies, collaborating on data cleaning and analysis to improve research outcomes.
positions.insights: Skills: Unreal Engine 4 · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · React.js

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a 3D video game to introduce algorithmic thinking to students without a computer science background.
• Applied principles of Agile methodologies to keep project on track.
• Ran VR usability experiments to gather gestures sets with the objective of improving efficiency and overall user experience on virtual environments.

company.name: Florida International University - College of Engineering & Computing

positions.title: Programming I Learning Assistant
positions.description:
• Reinforced lessons presented by teachers by mentoring students one-on-one or in small groups. 
• Assisted in the preparation of instructional material and implementation of lesson plans.

honors.title: Upsilon Pi Epsilon (UPE) Honor Society
honors.issuer: Issued by Florida International University School of Computing and Information Sciences · Apr 2020

honors.title: Ram Reality Create-A-Thon Outstanding Artistry Award
honors.description: Won the 2018 RamReality Create-a-thon Outstanding Artistry Award for creating a Virtual Reality experience that allows users to interact with different models of eyes across species. Users had the opportunity to move through and experience the healthy eye as well as the aging eye, and various ocular conditions such as cataracts and retinal degeneration.
honors.issuer: Issued by Colorado State University · Oct 2018
